name: partition-heal
description: The network splits into two equal-stake halves for three slots (1.2 s) and the transaction is submitted mid-partition. Alpenglow: neither half reaches 60%, so nothing finalizes (and nothing conflicting ever can) until the heal, then votes flow and the chain resumes. TowerBFT: both halves keep producing blocks and voting on their own fork; after the heal, validators on the lighter fork are locked out (2, 4, 8 slots) until they can switch to the heaviest subtree.
